sections.h2: Owned here, staffed here, and never subcontracted
body: Precision Paint Experts is a locally owned painting company in North Central Florida, run from Newberry by people who have spent more than fifteen years at the trade. Our clients range from single homeowners to business owners, property managers, HOA boards, churches, and schools, spread over five counties: Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist.

We don't subcontract. Whoever measures your house and prices the work is also the lead standing on your driveway each morning of the job, so there is one name and one phone number from start to finish.

sections.h2: Lessons North Central Florida weather has taught us
body: Paint in this region has to work harder than it looks. Sticky months on end, a storm most summer afternoons, sun that cooks the south and west walls, and a yellow coat of pine and oak pollen every spring all chip away at a finish. Pick the wrong product or paint at the wrong time of day and you'll be repainting years too early.

So the surface decides the product, never habit. Our paints come from premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines, and the rule of thumb runs like this: an all-acrylic finish for siding and exterior trim, elastomeric where stucco is flexing at fine cracks, a waterborne urethane enamel for anything hands touch daily such as cabinets, doors, and railings, and stain that soaks into raw wood. In July and August, outside work begins soon after sunrise, and the crew lead tracks the dew point and the storm radar. Our article on why humidity makes paint peel shows what goes wrong when those habits slip.

sections.h2: The order every Precision Paint Experts job follows
body: Every job follows the same order. It opens with a site visit: tape measure out, camera out, moisture meter on anything suspect. Next comes the written estimate, which names each surface, each prep task, each product, and how many coats. Preparation is booked as separate days, covering the wash, scraping and sanding, mildew treatment, setting popped nails, swapping rotten wood and fascia, caulking, and priming bare spots. Only then does finish paint go on, never fewer than two full coats, and where we spray, a brush or roller follows to work the paint into the surface.

The final step is a walk around the finished work with you, punch list in hand, and nothing is closed out until every item is right and you have signed. Leftover paint is labelled and left with you, and outside projects include a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, stacked on the manufacturer's own product coverage.

Homes and businesses get the same standards from us. On the residential side, that means residential painting inside and out, cabinet refinishing, deck and fence staining, and the repairs that come first. Commercial clients range from offices, shops, and restaurants to warehouses, churches, schools, apartment buildings, and HOA neighborhoods, and their crews work around business hours, late evenings and weekends included.

Staying in North Central Florida lets us know the buildings well, from older wood-frame homes to block-and-stucco houses and commercial buildings along the interstate. It also means the people who painted your house are close by if you ever need a warranty visit.

sections.h2: Credentials and options that matter to clients
bullets: A Florida license and bond, full insurance, and workers' comp for each painter we employ
An insurance certificate made out to your HOA, management firm, or company, issued before mobilization
Low-VOC and eco-conscious material options for occupied homes, offices, and classrooms

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts locally owned?
faqs.a: Yes. The company is owned locally, operates out of Newberry, FL, and takes work only within North Central Florida.
No. Our own employees do every bit of the painting, and the crew lead who wrote your estimate runs the job.

faqs.q: How much experience does your team have?
faqs.a: The business brings 15+ years of experience across homes, commercial buildings, and specialty coatings.
Yes. Ask for the low-VOC, eco-conscious products when you book; families with a nursery, offices that stay open, and schools often choose them.
